disqualifier.note: Expansion of addRequestBody.unexpectedPayload with omitted hasRequestPayload (body OR bytes OR formData). The unexpected-* probes are pairwise ORs over the same independent optional slots; overlapping true is legal and each XAiRequestBodyKind arm inspects one probe. AND/OR aliases of those slots are not a masked union.

Independent URL axes AND-combined in one type-side filter: URLStr.is versus not ending with a slash. A URLStr with a trailing slash is the supported input of the decode transform; the check rejects the slash independently of absolute-URL validity.
